overview: Open-source monitoring and alerting toolkit that scrapes metrics into a time-series database. This package adds Pushgateway and Alertmanager.
description:
Prometheus is an open-source systems monitoring and alerting toolkit. It collects metrics by scraping HTTP endpoints, stores them in a built-in time-series database, and provides a powerful query language (PromQL) plus alerting rules for building dashboards and alerts.

This package deploys the official prom/prometheus image together with Pushgateway for pushing batch-job metrics and Alertmanager for handling alerts. The scrape configuration lives in src/prometheus.yml and the web console is published on port 9090. Metrics and alert state are persisted in named volumes.

Typical use cases include infrastructure and application monitoring, Kubernetes and cloud-native observability, capacity planning, and alerting pipelines integrated with Grafana or other visualization tools.
